method: Method A/B hybrid (relaunch story). The account has a genuine 2024 pilot baseline and a 2026 scale-up under active management. 'Then' = first complete pilot month (Jul 2024); 'now' = most recent complete month (Jul 2026).
metric_definition: Genuine lead = 'lead' (Meta instant-form submission). Account-level results.value is 'Not available' every month (aggregated across attribution settings for mixed objectives), so it is not used. Months running only messaging campaigns (Mar/Apr 2026) report no instant-form leads.

scale_up_2026.note: Instant-form lead volume across the three scale-up months; average CPL = (1083.42+1282.62+1487.09)/(54+54+80) = 3853.13/188 = 20.49

presentation_note: A ~16-month pause (Nov 2024-Feb 2026) separates the two eras; disclosed openly. March and April 2026 ran messaging-objective campaigns, so their instant-form lead counts are not shown (they were not the objective those months). Story is kept honest as a pilot-to-scale relaunch, not a continuous run.
